name: Controller of Budget
description: Oversees implementation of national and county budgets.

name: Kenya Agricultural Market Information System
description: Agricultural market price and supply information system.

name: The National Treasury and Economic Planning
description: National fiscal, budget and economic-policy authority.

name: National Council for Law Reporting — Kenya Law
External open-data maintainers
description: Community-maintained extracts used only with explicit provenance and quality status.

name: Kenya Data Atlas
description: The Atlas itself, as publisher of transparent derivations computed from other agencies' underlying data (e.g. land area computed from boundary geometry). Used only where the statistical-publication-policy's basis 5 ("a transparent Atlas derivation or model") applies, with methodology published and reviewable.

name: World Bank Group
description: International development institution and publisher of World Development Indicators. In the Atlas, WDI is treated as a secondary harmonising compiler, never as a Kenyan primary statistical agency.

name: Office of the Auditor-General
description: Kenya’s supreme public-sector audit institution and publisher of county-government audit opinions.

name: Parliament of Kenya
description: Official Parliament of Kenya publisher for National Assembly membership and proceedings.
